title: Qualitative analysis, chaotic structure and exact solution of the nonlinear seventh-order Caudrey-Dodd-Gibbon-KP equation
summary: The main objective of this work is to investigate the traveling wave solution and dynamic characteristics of the (2 + 1)-dimensional seventh-order Caudrey-Dodd-Gibbon-KP (sCDG-KP) equation. Applying the ($\frac{G^{\prime}}{G^{\prime}+G+A}$) method, we examine the exact solution of the (2 + 1)-dimensional seventh-order Caudrey-Dodd-Gibbon-KP (sCDG-KP) equation by altering it into a reduced ODE via a suitable wave transformation.
